acceptance.deadline_termination: PASS - A synthetic 30-second child was terminated/reaped after a 0.1-second budget.
acceptance.bounded_stdout_and_sanitized_errors: PASS - Small stdout is normalized for text parsing; nonzero child output content is not included in the raised error.
